Retained general-only prototype fitting evidence; not a newly published initializer artifact

limitations: Synthetic latent compute only, not end-to-end training throughput or a quality comparison.
VAE/TE/IO, partition/global adapters, EMA and Block Swap are excluded.
Input creation and CUDA allocator reset occur outside the measured interval.
Native base remains unchanged on disk; each arm uses a fresh model and optimizer.
Each batch has one warm-up and three timed updates; model and optimizer continue between batches.
Hybrid uses retained general-only 3300-update prototype weights, not a public initializer export.
Swap uses the production spatial bridge class and saved general calibration; fitting cost is excluded.
No explicit host-device activation offload is used in this compute comparison.
